C-TABLE-SEQUENTIAL-RESIZE.Name: Preserve adjacent-column sizing across sequential fitted-table drags
C-TABLE-SEQUENTIAL-RESIZE.ApprovalBasis: Owner report on 2026-11-10 defines the expected result: narrow the first column, then the second, retaining two narrow left columns and one wide right column. Owner confirmed Mark Stabilization Test 2.8.2 and Fit mode. Existing session delegation covers routine repair and verification decisions.
C-TABLE-SEQUENTIAL-RESIZE.Summary: Repair the confirmed global redistribution and content-minimum reapplication that overwrite manual table geometry.

Goals.Goal: In Fit/Full, moving an internal border transfers width between its adjacent columns, keeps other columns and the outer frame unchanged, and respects the supported minimum. Repeated drags retain earlier boundary choices.
Content wrapping, render/refit, persisted adoption and mode round trips retain valid manually chosen proportions; natural content fitting remains automatic.

Constraints.Item: Keep ordinary Auto resizing behavior, no internal scrolling, narrow-frame squeeze, explicit Auto reset, profile schema, Markdown/history/saved state and original test/coverage thresholds. No new mode or UI control, dependency/version/release change, or modification of an open user document.

NonGoals.Item: No Auto sizing redesign, new mode/control, schema migration, version/tag/publication or mutation of open user documents.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The owner sequence fails on the base and passes after the repair with real pointer events. Long content does not expand the narrowed columns during reconciliation. Unrelated columns, total frame, saved state and exact Markdown remain stable.
Clamps, repeated/reversed gestures, four-column nonparticipants, same-frame reconciliation and persistence are covered. Existing Auto/no-scroll and table/viewer suites pass.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-012 TableResize and its current verification.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Red/green gesture and reconciliation tests, Chromium/WebKit pointer cases, full affected table/viewer gate, renderer build and fresh attributable QA when application inputs change.
